adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, the record is fetched via `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` (may return `nil`). `save_host(host)` then unconditionally does `host.host = ...` / `host.category_id = ...`, and `destroy` unconditionally calls `host.destroy`, which will raise `NoMethodError` and produce a 500 instead of a 404 when the id is unknown. Additionally, `save_host` accesses `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `[:category_id]` without guarding against a missing `:embeddable_host` key, which can also raise.
